messages:
Priya (oncall): Heads-up: got a family emergency, need to hand off the 23:00-01:00 UTC primary shift. Can someone cover 23:00-00:00? I can resume 00:00-01:00 as secondary if necessary. Sorry for the scramble.

incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff window opens at 22:50 UTC. Current rota: primary -> Priya (oncall), secondary -> Alex M.

Alex M: I'm on a travel call until 23:15 UTC. Can pick up 00:00-02:00 if that helps, but can't be primary on 23:00 immediate swap.

Riley - Eng Oncall: I can take 23:00-00:00 primary. I'll be at my desk and reachable on phone. Please post active alerts before handoff.

Priya (oncall): Thanks @Riley. Two quick things before swap: 1) KV-cache is at 70% and may hit GC cycle if traffic spikes, 2) model-fallback policy currently active for gptx-8q on low-memory nodes. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handbook (section: short-swap).

Zoe (shadow): I'll join the handoff at 22:40 to shadow and take notes. Which zoom link is the canonical one tonight?

Priya (oncall): Use zoom: https://meet.redwood/handovers. Zoe, shadow checklist: confirm alert dedupe keys, reproduce recent 502s with `curl -v`, check model queue depth in Grafana (panel: inference->queue), and watch for 'rate-limiter' logs.

Ben: Quick flag: rota shows nobody listed 02:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow after changes. If that stays empty we should mark it on the calendar as "escalation-only" and pre-notify infra-oncall. I'll open a rotation PR.

Riley - Eng Oncall: I'll accept 23:00-00:00 now. Posting handoff summary at 22:58.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: Riley - Eng Oncall accepted primary assignment for 23:00-00:00. Handoff id assigned: 2201234567.

Priya (oncall): Handoff checklist (copy/paste into calendar and thread):
```
- Active alerts: 2x generation-timeout alerts (alert URLs included)
- Mitigations: rate-limit decreased to 75% for public tier, fallback to gptx-8q-lite enabled
- Risk note: KV-cache ~70% (eviction risk), a transient spike could cause reconnect storms
- Open tickets: #4251 model-oom retries (owner: infra-runbooks), #4298 customer report (owner: support)
- Escalation chain: Alex M -> Riley -> infra-oncall -> oncall-exec
```

Zoe (shadow): Saw the checklist, copying to the shadow doc. Any quick tip for triage order when generation-timeout fires repeatedly?

Priya (oncall): If timeouts repeat, 1) check CPU vs GPU throttling on node (Grafana), 2) confirm if it's single model or multi-model fanout, 3) toggle fallback for the model family, 4) decide whether to post status update (P1 threshold). The customer-impact matrix is in the runbook under "impact + comms".

Ben: Suggestion: add a Slack slash command to record handoffs automatically: `/handoff save @user 23:00-00:00 note` so we don't lose ad-hoc swaps. Filing ID: INFRA-912.

Riley - Eng Oncall: Posted the handoff snapshot at 22:58 and added the one-line "what's risky": 'KV-cache at 70% -> eviction risk; watch reconnect rate'. Also pasted to calendar event.

incident-bot: Handoff snapshot saved: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/2201234567 (includes alerts, mitigations, participants).

Zoe (shadow): Joined zoom, observed one real alert and a dry-run. Filling shadow log now and will populate Confluence 'oncall-shadow-notes' link.

Priya (oncall): FYI for the new shadower: when escalating to infra, include `#customer-impact` tag in the pager text and attach last 500 lines of logs (script: `./tools/collect-logs --since 10m`). It speeds resolution.

Alex M: Noted. Taking 00:00-02:00 slot as arranged. Also I'll try to cover the 02:00-03:00 gap if Ben's PR doesn't land.

Riley - Eng Oncall: Took over at 23:00 UTC. Monitoring latency percentiles and queue depth. No P0s at takeover.

Ben: Thanks everyone. I'll loop rotation leads and propose the extra coverage in the schedule thread; also tracking the infra ticket for the slash command.

Zoe (shadow): Shadowing complete at 23:00, learned the triage flow and copied the example commands into my notes. Will do a short writeup in Confluence.

Priya (oncall): Appreciate the help. Riley, Alex 9— please call me if anything escalates. Good handoff.

incident-bot: Thread archived for handoff id 2201234567."
